children: RNS Number : 1148A  Asiamet Resources Limited  22 October 2026

Asiamet Resources Limited announces that the Annual General Meeting (“AGM”) of the Company will be held at the offices of Bird & Bird LLP, 12 New Fetter Lane, London EC4A 1JP at 11.00 a.m. (GMT) on 26 November 2026.
The Notice of AGM and Form of Proxy are now available on the Company’s website at www.asiametresources.com and are being posted to shareholders.
ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
James Spinney / James Dance / Rob Patrick
